Agent Name: WebSurfer  
Step Number: 8  
Reason for Mistake: WebSurfer failed to utilize the filtering tools on Redfin efficiently. Despite repeated instructions to apply filters for Single Family homes sold in January 2023, WebSurfer persisted in scrolling without effectively setting the necessary filters. This led to unnecessary repetition and prevented the retrieval of the required data. The behavior matches the error pattern of repetitive actions without progress (Error Signatures: Example 1, 3, and 6). The failure to fully configure filters and properly utilize tools to narrow down the search scope impeded task completion.
